notes.title: HexWind Update 5
notes.notes:
We’re just over two weeks into our Steam Early Access, and the feedback and support has been outstanding - both the happy reactions AND the constructive criticism on what our new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739340/HexWind/]HexWind[/url] needs to reach its full potential!

Today, we’re excited to be rolling out major features that address some of the main requests about game progression.

Put another way, we heard it loud and clear: “hey, the combat is great, but how do missions fit together?”

Luckily, expanding this aspect was ALWAYS in the works for us after tightening the core combat loop.

Without further ado, here’s how we’re bringing an exciting new progression system to HexWind:

[h2]🔥 Introducing the Mausoleum![/h2]
Get ready for the new Mausoleum, where you'll choose and prepare for missions. Inside, you'll progress through connected missions across the new map on the mysterious Sarcophagus of Fated Winds.

This magical map allows you to select new chaos rifts, challenges, and missions to conquer, making the game much more than a collection of disconnected battles; it's a gauntlet designed to test your stamina, reflexes, and mastery of magic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307721/3c495219a9b25dc9655bf8f5afaec50ad3391800.png[/img]

[h2]🌟 Meet Chance, the New NPC[/h2]
In a world...with no NPCs...you get a bit lonely.

The inquisitor’s been aching for a friend. So we delivered.

Say hello to Chance, our first NPC, a mysterious observer of the endless battle between Order (HexWind) and Chaos (the Blind God).

Seek him out in the Mausoleum and other areas to discover how he can influence your journey.

Stay with us to see how we flesh Chance out in future updates!


[h2]💀 Experience the New Death....[/h2]
In HexWind, dying isn't the end—it's more of a stepping stone.

With this new update, your next death might be a bit...different...


[h2]We know these additions bring a whole new dimension to HexWind, that player have been asking for![/h2]

It's time to jump back in, test your reflexes, and embrace the sweet sting of defeat (and, perhaps, triumph?)

As always, your feedback is the wind beneath our wings.

Head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739340/HexWind/]Steam page for HexWind[/url] to check it out!

Cheers,

The Charm Games Team 💖

notes.title: HexWind Update 2: Core Closed Beta Improvements
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey adventurers! 🌬️✨[/h1]

We’re very excited about this significant update, which is bringing some fundamental changes that amp up the experience, and some highly-requested tweaks from our Beta players. In many ways, it’s a brand new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739340/HexWind/]HexWind[/url] - so we are excited for you to head over to the page and feel the difference.

Once again, we need to take a moment to say how your feedback has continued to inspire us – without further ado, here’s what’s new!

[h2]🌪️ Chaos Rift Battles - A Major New and Fundamental Addition to the Game[/h2]
Step into the Chaos Rifts—mysterious portals that plunge you into intense battles. Experience the thrill of fighting waves of enemies, dodging traps, and navigating arcane beams, all within the distortion of Hextime.

Let’s be clear - The intensity is turned UP in these battles, as you race to gather rift shards from fallen enemies. Maybe it’s just us, but we often broke a sweat during testing.
Beat all challenges to reseal the rifts and continue on your journey.

[h2]🌀 Wand Motion Combat - A major addition to the control scheme[/h2]
Highly requested and now here! Players can unleash new offensive magic with Wand Motion Combat! Now, swiping or slashing your wand creates powerful magical attacks. Get creative with your movements and discover new ways to defeat your foes. This leverages the player’s style and finesse to create a more visceral way to ‘feel’ like a wizard.

[h2]⚔️ New Mini-Boss: Cinderwraith[/h2]
Meet Cinderwraith, a formidable skeleton mini-boss with a penchant for spears. Prepare yourself for an epic showdown—we think he’ll soon enter the ranks of one of the toughest skeletons in gaming.
[h2]
⚡ Lightning Impale[/h2]
Introducing the Lightning Impale ability: impale enemies with lightning and slam them into the ground—or into other enemies. It's a powerful new way to turn the tide in battle, and add an electrifying (groan…) experience to the gameplay.

As you can see, this update brings a ton of new functionality that bring this Beta experience a massive leap ahead in terms of showcasing our vision for the gameplay.

We know that these new features will fundamentally alter your experience and so we urge you to check them out when you can.

As always, your feedback is invaluable—please share your thoughts and experiences. Together, we're crafting something truly special.

Happy adventuring!
The Charm Games Team

notes.title: What's New - HexWind Beta Update #1
notes.notes:
Once again, we can’t say it enough: thank you to everyone taking the time to participate in our closed beta for our latest VR game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739340/HexWind/]HexWind[/url]!

We've got some exciting updates fresh out of the oven, and we’ll be sharing in more detail what’s recently released, and what’s coming up.

Your feedback has been amazing, and it's helping us shape the game into something truly special. Here's what's new this week, and of course, we’d love if our Beta group could check them out and give us their thought:

—
New features already live:

[h2]Chaos Lord Just Got... Chaotic-er?[/h2]
The Chaos Lord (you know, the big boss in the beta) has upped his game thanks to some recent updates. Now, when his sword hits the ground, he creates arcane beams that shoot outwards like the Chaos Crystal. Translation: A tougher challenge we hope leads to more epic battles in your beta experience.

Pop back in and we’d love to hear what you think!

[h2]New Spell: Lightning Strike[/h2]
This nifty new spell automatically fires a lightning bolt whenever you shoot your wand, giving you an extra zap in combat.

[h2]Handy New UI Elements[/h2]
We heard you loud and clear—keeping track of stats and upgrades was a bit tricky. So, we've added new UI elements! Now, when you hit pause, you'll see your character stats, items, and upgrades all neatly displayed. Knowledge is power, so we’ll be continuing to work hard on making our UI and HUD as helpful (and as seamless) as possible 

[h2]Smooth Turn Option[/h2]
For those of you who prefer smooth turning, we’ve added that option in the player settings. Access it from the pause menu to choose between Snap and Smooth turning.

[h2]Explore New Areas in the Catacombs Zone[/h2]
Cavern of Woe: Venture into this mysterious new area filled with secrets and challenges, although you may need to upgrade your magical abilities to do so. 

Hall of Mourning: The final resting place for many of the order’s fallen heroes, now contains powerful malevolent reanimated horrors.

We can't wait to hear about your adventures in these new areas, and of course, we look forward to yet more environment releases we’ve got coming next week!

—

[h2]Coming Soon! 

Boosting the Rogue-like Experience and Replayability
[/h2]

One of our most important priorities is to continually dial up the rogue-like game elements to make each run feel unique and exciting! Here’s what’s in development and arriving soon:

[h3]Player Blessings V1:[/h3] These are run-specific upgrades that stack as you continue - they reset each time you start a new quest or path.

[h3]Unlockable Wind Magic[/h3] Upgrades: Soon, you’ll be able to unlock abilities like dash, double jump, and extra charges of wind magic during your run. We know these will help you customize your playstyle and find new ways to navigate the world!

[h3]New mini-bosses:[/h3] We can’t wait for you to check out our new enemy types, including our Void Initiate, a floating mini-boss enemy that can cast many flaming skull heads to seek and destroy you. 

These features will add more depth and replayability, so every time you play, there's something new to experience. 

---

We're super excited for you to check out these updates. Your input has been instrumental in getting us this far, so please keep the feedback coming!

Happy adventuring, and may the winds be ever in your favor!

notes.title: 1.6.0 Update
notes.notes:
Update 1.6.0 is now live!

[list]
[*]Index controller users will see significantly improved hand positioning and smoother in-game interactions
[*]Pause menu usability improvements and fixes for text rendering issues seen on some hardware configurations
[*]Several other minor bug fixes
[/list]

For issues with this update or anything else in-game, send us an email at support@charmgames.com

Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.5.0 Update
notes.notes:
This update has been a long time coming! In addition to a few minor bug fixes, you'll get:
[list]
[*][b]Oculus SDK Support[/b] - Oculus users will now experience FORM running natively using the Oculus SDK. Many of you will see performance improvements from this, depending on your particular VR configuration.
[*][b]In-game Recentering[/b] - You can now recenter yourself in-game using the “Recenter” option available in the pause menu. This should work for any player using any headset. We hope this makes life a little better for any of you with a tight or unique room setup.
[/list]
For any issues with this update, send us an email at support@charmgames.com. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: FORM Update 1.1 - Cortex Mode and more!
notes.notes:
Hi folks, 

What an amazing few weeks. Thank you so much for the kind words you've had for FORM. This was a true passion project for us, and your encouragement is what keeps us energized to continue supporting FORM and working on new VR experiences. 

Today we're bringing you the first update to FORM, including a new feature - Cortex Mode, Oculus Rift support, and improved optimization and performance settings. 

As always, if you run into any issues, you can reach out to us on social media - @charmgames. You can also post a message on our discussion page and one of us will try to help as soon as we're able.

Thank you!

-Alan

Updates:
[list]
[*] Cortex Mode - an interactive game soundtrack for FORM. Chill out, sit down, listen to relaxing music, and escape the world as environments from the world of FORM transform around you. 
[*] Oculus Rift support - FORM is now fully supported on Oculus Rift headsets when using Steam. 
[*] Achievements!
[*] Quality Settings - FORM will now automatically choose a quality setting on start based on your PC specs. You can manually change quality in the Settings window in the Main Menu.
[*] Optimization - Continued optimization should improve performance across all parts of the game, particularly if you're using the setting automatically detected for your PC.
[/list]

Known issues:
[list]
[*][strike]FORM can fail to initialize in Oculus Rift headsets when using Steam. We're treating this as a critical bug and are working on a hotfix right now.[/strike] Fixed! FORM is now supported on Oculus Rift headsets when using Steam. Rift users, if you experience further issues, please let us know.
[*]Pause menu text is whited out when viewed at some angles and distances. 
[/list]
